import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    static final long LIM = Long.MAX_VALUE - MOD * MOD;

    static class Matrix {
        int size;
        long[][] mat;

        Matrix(int s) {
            size = s;
            mat = new long[s + 1][s + 1];
        }

        void setIdentity() {
            for (int i = 0; i <= size; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= size; ++j) {
                    mat[i][j] = (i == j) ? 1 : 0;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int gcd(int a, int b) {
        return b == 0 ? a : gcd(b, a % b);
    }

    static void multiply(Matrix A, Matrix B, Matrix C) {
        int s = A.size;
        for (int i = 0; i <= s; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= s; ++j) {
                long sum = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k <= s; ++k) {
                    if (sum > LIM) sum %= MOD;
                    sum += A.mat[i][k] * B.mat[k][j];
                }
                C.mat[i][j] = sum % MOD;
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long n = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        int base = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int size = base;
        // Initialize 4D array: mat[61][size][size][size+1]
        Matrix[][][][] mat = new Matrix[61][size][size][size + 1];

        for (int i = 0; i < 61; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size; ++j) {
                for (int k = 0; k < size; ++k) {
                    for (int l = 0; l <= size; ++l) {
                        mat[i][j][k][l] = new Matrix(size);
                        for (int m = 0; m <= size; ++m) {
                            for (int n = 0; n <= size; ++n) {
                                mat[i][j][k][l].mat[m][n] = 0;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        Matrix have = new Matrix(size);
        Matrix tmp = new Matrix(size);

        // Initialize mat[0][i][j][k]
        for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size; ++j) {
                for (int k = 0; k <= size; ++k) {
                    for (int l = 0; l <= size; ++l) {
                        mat[0][i][j][k].mat[k][l] = (k == l || j == l) ? 1 : 0;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int ci = 0;
        long step = 1;
        while (step <= n / size) {
            ++ci;
            step *= size;
        }

        // Build higher powers
        for (int i = 1; i <= ci; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size; ++j) {
                // set identity for mat[i][j][j][j]
                mat[i][j][j][j].setIdentity();
                for (int k = 0; k < size; ++k) {
                    multiply(mat[i][j][k], mat[i - 1][(j + k) % size][k], tmp);
                    mat[i][j][k] = tmp;
                }
            }
        }

        // Initialize 'have' as identity matrix
        have.setIdentity();

        int cj = 0;
        for (; ci >= 0; --ci, step /= size) {
            int times = (int)((n / step) % size);
            for (int x = 0; x < times; ++x) {
                multiply(have, mat[ci][cj][0], tmp);
                have = tmp;
                cj++;
                if (cj >= size) cj -= size;
            }
        }

        long result = 0;
        for (int k = 0; k <= size; ++k) {
            result += have.mat[k][size];
            if (result >= MOD) result -= MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
